sloka: तां तर्ज्यमानां सम्प्रेक्ष्य राक्षसेन्द्रेण जानकीम् ।देवगन्धर्वकन्यास्ता विषेदुर्विपुलेक्षणाः ।। ५.२०.१०।।।।
transliteration: tāṁ tarjyamānāṁ samprekṣya rākṣasendreṇa jānakīm ।devagandharvakanyāstā viṣedurvipulekṣaṇāḥ ।। 5.20.10।।।।

translations.english: "O Mythili having secured me, you get all these comforts wonderful garlands, sandal, incense, garments and beautiful ornaments, rich drinks, beds and seats.You can enjoy songs, dances accompanied by musical instruments.
translations.hindi: क्योकि यदि उनके साथ तेरा संसर्ग हुआ होता, तो तेरी ऐसी सदाचारहीन बुद्धि कभी न होती या सज्जनों के हितकर वचनों को मिथ्या समझ
